title.zh: 卷39 列傳第31 韋瑱 梁昕 皇甫璠 辛慶之 王子直 杜杲
title.en: Volume 39 Biographies 31: Wei Zhen; Liang Xin; Huang Fufan; Xin Qingzhi; Wang Zizhi; Du Gao
title.raw: 卷39 列傳第31 韋瑱 梁昕 皇甫璠 辛慶之 王子直 杜杲 Volume 39 Biographies 31: Wei Zhen; Liang Xin; Huang Fufan; Xin Qingzhi; Wang Zizhi; Du Gao

sentences.zh: 韋瑱字世珍，京兆杜陵人也。

translations.literal: Wei Zhen, styled Shizhen, was a man of Duling in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zhen, courtesy name Shizhen, came from Duling in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 世為三輔著姓。

translations.literal: For generations a prominent clan of the Three Metropolises.
translations.idiomatic: His family had long been a leading house of the Three Metropolises.

sentences.zh: 曾祖惠度，姚泓尚書郎。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Huidu was a masters of writing gentleman under Yao Hong.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Huidu had served Yao Hong as a gentleman of the masters of writing.

sentences.zh: 隨劉義真過江，仕宋為鎮西府司馬、順陽太守，行南雍州事。

translations.literal: Following Liu Yizhen across the Yangtze, he served Song as western garrison headquarters marshal, Administrator of Shunyang, and acting southern Yong Province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed the Yangtze with Liu Yizhen and served the Song as marshal of the western garrison headquarters, administrator of Shunyang, and acting governor of southern Yong.

sentences.zh: 後於襄陽歸魏，拜中書侍郎，贈安西將軍、洛州刺史。

translations.literal: Later at Xiangyang he submitted to Wei, was appointed vice director of the Palace Secretariat, and posthumously given General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Luo Province.
translations.idiomatic: Later, at Xiangyang, he went over to Wei and was made vice director of the palace secretariat; after death he was posthumously honored as general who pacifies the west and governor of Luo.

sentences.zh: 祖千雄，略陽郡守。

translations.literal: His grandfather Qianxiong was Administrator of Lueyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Qianxiong had been administrator of Lueyang commandery.

sentences.zh: 父英，代郡守，贈兗州刺史。

translations.literal: His father Ying was Administrator of Dai commandery, posthumously given Governor of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ying was administrator of Dai commandery and was posthumously made governor of Yan.

sentences.zh: 瑱幼聰敏，有夙成之量，閭里咸敬異之。

translations.literal: Zhen from youth was clever and perceptive, had precocious capacity; neighbors all honored and marveled at him.
translations.idiomatic: From boyhood Zhen was quick and perceptive, with gifts beyond his years, and everyone in the neighborhood looked on him with respect and wonder.

sentences.zh: 篤志好學，兼善騎射。

translations.literal: Devoted in will and fond of learning, also skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: He was single-minded in study and also excelled at horsemanship and archery.

sentences.zh: 魏孝昌三年，起家太尉府法曹參軍。

translations.literal: In the third year of Wei Xiaochang he first took office as legal bureau adjutant in the Grand Commandant's office.
translations.idiomatic: In Wei Xiaochang year 3 he entered service as legal bureau adjutant in the grand commandant's office.

sentences.zh: 稍遷直後，除明威將軍、雍州治中，假鎮遠將軍、防城州將。

translations.literal: Progressively transferred to rear guard; appointed General of Bright Might and chief administrator of Yong Province; acting General Who Stabilizes the Distant and garrison commander of Fangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to rear guard, then general of bright might and chief administrator of Yong, with acting rank as general who stabilizes the distant and garrison commander of Fangcheng.

sentences.zh: 累遷諫議大夫、冠軍將軍。

translations.literal: Repeatedly promoted to grand adviser remonstrating and general who conquers.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in succession to grand adviser remonstrating and general who conquers.

sentences.zh: 太祖為丞相，加前將軍、太中大夫，封長安縣男，食邑三百戶。

translations.literal: When the Grand Progenitor became chancellor, added Former General and Grand Master of Palace Counsel; enfeoffed Baron of Chang'an county with fief of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai became chancellor, Zhen was given the added ranks of former general and grand master of palace counsel and enfeoffed baron of Chang'an with a fief of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 轉行臺左丞，加撫軍將軍、銀青光祿大夫，遷使持節、都督南郢州諸軍事、南郢州刺史。

translations.literal: Transferred to left assistant director of the mobile headquarters; added General Who Pacifies the Army and Silver-Crown Grand Master of Splendid Happiness; moved to bearer of the staff, area commander of military affairs for Nan Ying Province, Governor of Nan Ying.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to left assistant director of the mobile headquarters, given the added titles of general who pacifies the army and silver-crown grand master of splendid happiness, and appointed bearer of the staff, area commander of Nan Ying, and governor of Nan Ying.

sentences.zh: 復入為行臺左丞。

translations.literal: Again entered service as left assistant director of the mobile headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to the capital as left assistant director of the mobile headquarters.

sentences.zh: 瑱明察有幹局，再居左轄，時論榮之。

translations.literal: Zhen was perceptive and capable; twice holding the left assistant post, contemporary opinion honored him.
translations.idiomatic: Clear-sighted and able, Zhen twice held the left assistant directorship and was widely praised for it.

sentences.zh: 從復弘農，戰沙苑，加衛大將軍、左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Following recovery of Hongnong, battle at Shaye; added Grand General of the Guard and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the campaign to recover Hongnong and fought at Shaye, for which he was given grand general of the guard and left grand master of splendid happiness.

sentences.zh: 又從戰河橋，進爵為子，增邑二百戶。

translations.literal: Again following battle at Heqiao; advanced enfeoffment to viscount, increased fief by two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He fought again at Heqiao, was raised to viscount, and his fief was increased by two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 大統八年，齊神武侵汾、絳，瑱從太祖禦之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Datong, Gao Huan invaded Fen and Jiang; Zhen followed the Grand Progenitor to resist.
translations.idiomatic: In Datong year 8, when Gao Huan invaded Fen and Jiang, Zhen followed Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai to meet him.

sentences.zh: 軍還，令瑱以本官鎮蒲津關，帶中潬城主。

translations.literal: Army returned; ordered Zhen with his existing rank to garrison Pujin Pass, concurrently city lord of Zhongtan.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, Zhen was ordered to hold Pujin Pass in his existing rank and also serve as lord of Zhongtan walled city.

sentences.zh: 尋除蒲州總管府長史。

translations.literal: Soon appointed chief administrator of the Puzhou headquarters command.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made chief administrator of the Puzhou headquarters command.

sentences.zh: 頃之，徵拜鴻臚卿。

translations.literal: Shortly after, summoned and appointed Minister of Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was summoned and appointed minister of ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 以望族，兼領鄉兵，加帥都督。

translations.literal: Because of eminent clan, concurrently commanded local militia; added area commander.
translations.idiomatic: As a man of a leading family, he also took charge of local militia and was given the added rank of area commander.

sentences.zh: 遷大都督、通直散騎常侍，行京兆郡事，進車騎大將軍、儀同三司、散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Promoted to grand area commander, regular attendant of direct communication and scattered cavalry; acting Jingzhao commandery affairs; advanced to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Equal in Three Departments, Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to grand area commander and regular attendant of direct communication and scattered cavalry, acted for Jingzhao commandery, and was advanced to grand general of chariots and cavalry, equal in three departments, and regular attendant of scattered cavalry.

sentences.zh: 魏恭帝二年，賜姓宇文氏。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wei Gongdi, granted surname Yuwen.
translations.idiomatic: In Wei Gongdi year 2 the Yuwen surname was bestowed on him.

sentences.zh: 三年，除瓜州諸軍事、瓜州刺史。

translations.literal: Third year, appointed commander of military affairs for Gua Province and Governor of Gua.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was appointed commander of military affairs for Gua and governor of Gua Province.

sentences.zh: 州通西域，蕃夷往來，前後刺史，多受賂遺。

translations.literal: Province connected to Western Regions; barbarians and foreigners came and went; former and later governors mostly received bribes and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The province lay on the route to the Western Regions, with tribesmen and foreigners passing through; governors before and after him had mostly taken bribes.

sentences.zh: 胡寇犯邊，又莫能禦。

translations.literal: Hu raiders violated the border, yet none could repel them.
translations.idiomatic: When Hu raiders struck the frontier, none of his predecessors had been able to stop them.

sentences.zh: 瑱雅性清儉，兼有武略。

translations.literal: Zhen by nature was pure and frugal, also possessed military strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen was by nature upright and austere, and he also had real military talent.

sentences.zh: 蕃夷贈遺，一無所受。

translations.literal: Gifts from barbarians and foreigners — entirely none accepted.
translations.idiomatic: He refused every gift offered by tribesmen and foreign traders.

sentences.zh: 胡人畏威，不敢為寇。

translations.literal: Hu people feared his authority, dared not raid.
translations.idiomatic: The Hu feared his authority and no longer dared raid.

sentences.zh: 公私安靜，夷夏懷之。

translations.literal: Public and private were tranquil; barbarians and Chinese embraced him.
translations.idiomatic: Public and private life grew calm, and both barbarians and Chinese came to trust him.

sentences.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，進爵平齊縣伯，增邑五百戶。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin ascended the throne, advanced enfeoffment to Earl of Pingqi county, increased fief by five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, Zhen was raised to earl of Pingqi and his fief was increased by five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 秩滿還京，吏民戀慕，老幼追送，留連十數日，方得出境。

translations.literal: Term completed and returned to capital; officials and people longed for him; old and young pursued to send off; lingered over ten days before able to leave the border.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended and he returned to the capital, officials and commoners alike mourned his departure; old and young followed him for more than ten days before he could leave the province.

sentences.zh: 世宗嘉之，進授侍中、驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizong commended him; advanced appointment to Palace Attendant, Grand General of Flying Cavalry, Opening-Office Equal in Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong praised him and promoted him to palace attendant, grand general of flying cavalry, and opening-office equal in three departments.

sentences.zh: 武成三年，卒，時年六十一。

translations.literal: In the third year of Wucheng he died, aged sixty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Wucheng year 3, at the age of sixty-one.

sentences.zh: 贈岐宜二州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously given Governors of Qi and Yi provinces.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as governor of Qi and Yi.

sentences.zh: 諡曰惠。

translations.literal: Posthumous title: Hui.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Hui.

sentences.zh: 天和二年，又追封為公，增邑通前三千戶。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianhe, again posthumously enfeoffed as duke, fief increased to three thousand households in all with prior.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianhe year 2 he was posthumously raised to duke, bringing his fief to three thousand households in all.

sentences.zh: 仍詔其子峻襲。

translations.literal: Thereupon edicted his son Jun to inherit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered his son Jun to inherit the title.

sentences.zh: 峻後位至車騎大將軍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Jun later reached Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Equal in Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Jun later rose to grand general of chariots and cavalry and equal in three departments.

sentences.zh: 峻弟師，起家中外府記室，歷兵部小府下大夫。

translations.literal: Jun's younger brother Shi, first office domestic and foreign headquarters recorder; served as lower grand master in the small office of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Jun's younger brother Shi began as recorder in the domestic and foreign headquarters and served as lower grand master in the small office of the ministry of war.

sentences.zh: 建德末，蒲州總管府中郎，行河東郡事。

translations.literal: At the end of Jiande, middle director of Puzhou headquarters command; acting Hedong commandery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Jiande era he was middle director of the Puzhou headquarters command and acted for Hedong commandery.

sentences.zh: 梁昕字元明，安定烏氏人也。

translations.literal: Liang Xin, styled Yuanming, was a man of Wushi in Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Xin, courtesy name Yuanming, came from Wushi in Anding.

sentences.zh: 世為關中著姓。

translations.literal: For generations a prominent clan of Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: His family had long been a leading house of Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 其先因官，徙居京兆之盩厔焉。

translations.literal: His ancestors due to office moved to reside at Zizhi in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: An earlier generation had moved on official business to Zizhi in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 祖重耳，漳縣令。

translations.literal: Grandfather Zhong'er was magistrate of Zhang county.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zhong'er had been magistrate of Zhang county.

sentences.zh: 父勸儒，州主薄、冠軍將軍、中散大夫，贈涇州刺史。

translations.literal: Father Quanru was provincial chief clerk, General Who Conquers, Grand Master of Palace Dissemination, posthumously given Governor of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: His father Quanru had been provincial chief clerk, general who conquers, and grand master of palace dissemination, and was posthumously made governor of Jing.

sentences.zh: 昕少溫恭，見稱州里。

translations.literal: Xin from youth was warm and respectful; praised in the district.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Xin was gentle and courteous, and his neighbors spoke well of him.

sentences.zh: 正光五年，秦隴構亂，蕭寶夤為大都督，統兵出討，以昕為行臺參軍。

translations.literal: Fifth year of Zhenguang, Qin and Long stirred rebellion; Xiao Baoyin as grand general commanded troops to campaign; made Xin mobile headquarters adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenguang year 5, when Qin and Long rose in revolt, Xiao Baoyin took the field as grand general and made Xin an adjutant on his mobile headquarters staff.

sentences.zh: 孝昌初，拜蕩寇將軍，稍遷驤威將軍、給事中。

translations.literal: Early Xiaochang, appointed General Who Sweeps Bandits; gradually promoted to General of Soaring Might and palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Xiaochang era he was made general who sweeps bandits, then gradually rose to general of soaring might and palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 仍從寶夤征万俟醜奴。

translations.literal: Still followed Baoyin to campaign against Moqi Chounu.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed Baoyin on the campaign against Moqi Chounu.

sentences.zh: 相持二年，前後數十戰，以功

translations.literal: They stalemate two years; in dozens of battles before and after, by merit
translations.idiomatic: After two years of stalemate and dozens of battles, for his merit

translations.literal: (Enfeoff) [emended: Promote]
translations.idiomatic: [emended: promote]

sentences.zh: 〔進〕征西將軍。

translations.literal: [emended: Promote] to General Who Conquers the West.
translations.idiomatic: he was promoted to general who conquers the west.

sentences.zh: 爾朱天光入關，復引為外兵參軍。

translations.literal: Erzhu Tianguang entered the Pass; again recruited as outer troops adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Tianguang entered the Pass, Xin was again taken on as outer troops adjutant.

sentences.zh: 從天光征討，拜右將軍、太中大夫。

translations.literal: Following Tianguang on campaigns; appointed Right General and Grand Master of Palace Counsel.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Tianguang on campaign and was appointed right general and grand master of palace counsel.

sentences.zh: 太祖迎魏孝武，軍次雍州。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor welcomed Emperor Xiaowu of Wei; army halted at Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai went to welcome Emperor Xiaowu of Wei, the army halted at Yong.

sentences.zh: 昕以三輔望族上謁。

translations.literal: Xin as prominent clan of the Three Metropolises went up to pay respects.
translations.idiomatic: Xin, as a man of a leading Three Metropolises family, came forward to pay his respects.

sentences.zh: 太祖見昕容貌瑰偉，深賞異之。

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor saw Xin's appearance magnificent and stately; deeply prized and marveled.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai was struck by Xin's imposing looks and took a deep liking to him.

sentences.zh: 卽授右府長流參軍。

translations.literal: Immediately appointed chief recorder adjutant of the right office.
translations.idiomatic: He was at once made chief recorder adjutant of the right office.

sentences.zh: 大統初，加鎮南將軍、金紫光祿大夫，轉丞相府戶曹參軍。

translations.literal: Early Datong, added General Who Pacifies the South and Golden-Crown Grand Master of Splendid Happiness; transferred to households bureau adjutant in chancellor's office.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Datong he was given general who pacifies the south and golden-crown grand master of splendid happiness and transferred to households bureau adjutant in the chancellor's office.

sentences.zh: 從復弘農，戰沙苑，皆有功。

translations.literal: Following recovery of Hongnong, battle at Shaye — all had merit.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in recovering Hongnong and fighting at Shaye and was rewarded on both occasions.

sentences.zh: 除車騎將軍、丞相府主簿。

translations.literal: Appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry and chief clerk of chancellor's office.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed general of chariots and cavalry and chief clerk of the chancellor's office.

sentences.zh: 出為洛安郡守，徵拜大將軍行臺兵部郎中，加帥都督。

translations.literal: Out as Administrator of Luo'an commandery; summoned as Great General mobile headquarters bureau director of the Ministry of War, added area commander.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as administrator of Luo'an, was then recalled as great general and mobile headquarters bureau director of the ministry of war, and given the added rank of area commander.

sentences.zh: 十二年，除河南郡守，鎮大塢。

translations.literal: Twelfth year, appointed Administrator of Henan commandery, garrisoned Great Walled Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was made administrator of Henan commandery and garrisoned the Great Walled Fort.

sentences.zh: 尋又移鎮閻韓。

translations.literal: Soon again moved garrison to Yanhan.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he shifted his garrison to Yanhan.

sentences.zh: 式遏邊壘，甚著誠信。

translations.literal: Restraining border fortresses, greatly showed trustworthiness.
translations.idiomatic: He held the frontier strongpoints firmly and won a strong reputation for reliability.

sentences.zh: 遷東荊州刺史。

translations.literal: Promoted to Governor of East Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to governor of East Jing.

sentences.zh: 昕撫以仁惠，蠻夷悅之，流民歸附者，相繼而至。

translations.literal: Xin soothed with kindness and grace; barbarians pleased; refugees returning — continuously arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Xin governed with kindness and grace; the tribes were pleased, and displaced people kept coming back to settle under him.

sentences.zh: 封安定縣子，邑三百戶。

translations.literal: Enfeoffed Viscount of Anding county, fief three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed viscount of Anding with a fief of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 累遷大都督、車騎大將軍、散騎常侍、儀同三司。

translations.literal: Repeatedly promoted to grand area commander, Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, Equal in Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to grand area commander, grand general of chariots and cavalry, regular attendant of scattered cavalry, and equal in three departments.

sentences.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，進位驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: When Xiaomin ascended, advanced to Grand General of Flying Cavalry, Opening-Office Equal in Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, he was advanced to grand general of flying cavalry and opening-office equal in three departments.

sentences.zh: 世宗初，進爵胡城縣伯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: Early Shizong, advanced to Earl of Hucheng county, fief five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Emperor Shizong's reign he was raised to earl of Hucheng with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 三年，除九曲城主。

translations.literal: Third year, appointed lord of Jiuqu walled city.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made lord of Jiuqu walled city.

sentences.zh: 保定元年，遷中州刺史，增邑八百戶，轉邵州刺史。

translations.literal: First year of Baoding, moved to Governor of Zhong Province, increased fief eight hundred households; transferred to Governor of Shao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoding year 1 he was moved to governor of Zhong, his fief was increased by eight hundred households, and he was then transferred to governor of Shao.

sentences.zh: 二年，以母喪去職。

translations.literal: Second year, due to mother's mourning left office.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 尋起復本任。

translations.literal: Soon recalled to original post.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled to his former post.

sentences.zh: 天和初，徵拜工部中大夫。

translations.literal: Early Tianhe, summoned as middle grand master of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Tianhe he was summoned and appointed middle grand master of the ministry of works.

sentences.zh: 出為陝

translations.literal: Went out as Shaan
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed chief administrator of the

translations.literal: (West) [emended: Province]
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Province

sentences.zh: 〔州〕總管府長史。

translations.literal: [emended: Province] headquarters command chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: the Shaan Province headquarters command.

sentences.zh: 昕性溫裕，有幹能。

translations.literal: Xin's nature warm and generous, had capability.
translations.idiomatic: Xin was warm and even-tempered, and capable in office.

sentences.zh: 歷官內外，咸著聲稱。

translations.literal: Serving offices inner and outer, all showed reputation.
translations.idiomatic: In every post, civil or military, he won a strong reputation.

sentences.zh: 尋卒於位。

translations.literal: Soon died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward while still in office.

sentences.zh: 贈大將軍，諡曰貞。

translations.literal: Posthumously given Great General; posthumous title: Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as great general and given the posthumous title Zhen.

sentences.zh: 昕弟榮，歷位匠師下大夫，中外府中郎，蕃部、郡伯、司倉、計部下大夫，開府儀同三司，朝那縣伯，贈涇寧豳三州刺史，諡曰靜。

translations.literal: Xin's younger brother Rong, offices included lower grand master of craftsmen, middle director of domestic-foreign headquarters, various bureaus, lower grand master of accounting, Opening-Office Equal in Three Departments, Earl of Chaona county, posthumously given Governors of Jing, Ning, and Bin provinces, posthumous title Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Xin's younger brother Rong served as lower grand master of craftsmen, middle director of the domestic and foreign headquarters, bureau director in several ministries, lower grand master of accounting, opening-office equal in three departments, and earl of Chaona; after death he was posthumously made governor of Jing, Ning, and Bin and given the posthumous title Jing.

sentences.zh: 皇甫璠

translations.literal: Huangfu Fan
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Fan (璠)

sentences.zh: 皇甫璠字景瑜，安定三水人也。

translations.literal: Huangfu Fan, styled Jingyu, was a man of Sanshui in Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Fan, courtesy name Jingyu, came from Sanshui in Anding.

sentences.zh: 世為西州著姓，後徙居京兆焉。

translations.literal: For generations a prominent clan of West Province; later moved to reside in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: His family had long been a leading house of West Province and later moved to Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 父和，本州治中。

translations.literal: Father He was chief administrator of the province.
translations.idiomatic: His father He had been chief administrator of the province.

sentences.zh: 大統末，追贈散騎常侍、儀同三司、涇州刺史。

translations.literal: At the end of Datong, posthumously given Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry, Equal in Three Departments, Governor of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Datong he was posthumously honored as regular attendant of scattered cavalry, equal in three departments, and governor of Jing.

sentences.zh: 璠少忠謹，有幹略。

translations.literal: Fan from youth was loyal and careful, had capability and strategy.
translations.idiomatic: From youth Fan was dutiful and careful, with real talent and judgment.

sentences.zh: 永安中，辟州都督。

translations.literal: In the Yong'an era, recruited as area commander of the province.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yong'an era he was recruited as area commander of the province.

sentences.zh: 太祖為牧，補主薄。

translations.literal: When the Grand Progenitor became governor, supplemented as chief clerk.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai became governor, Fan was appointed chief clerk.

sentences.zh: 以勤事被知，每蒙褒賞。

translations.literal: Because of diligent service was known; repeatedly received commendation and reward.
translations.idiomatic: His diligence won notice, and he was praised and rewarded again and again.

sentences.zh: 大統四年，引為丞相府行參軍。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Datong, recruited as mobile adjutant in chancellor's office.
translations.idiomatic: In Datong year 4 he was brought onto the chancellor's staff as a mobile adjutant.

sentences.zh: 尋轉田曹參軍、東閤祭酒，加散騎侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon transferred to fields bureau adjutant and eastern pavilion libationer; added Vice Director of Scattered Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to fields bureau adjutant and eastern pavilion libationer and given the added rank of vice director of scattered cavalry.

sentences.zh: 稍遷兼太常少卿、都水使者，歷蕃部、兵部、虞部、民部、吏部等諸曹郎中。

translations.literal: Gradually promoted to concurrent Vice Director of the Grand Master of Ceremonial and commissioner of waterways; served as bureau director in the bureaus of Barbarian Affairs, War, Parks and Forests, People, and Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to concurrent vice director of the grand master of ceremonial and commissioner of waterways, and served as bureau director in the ministries of barbarian affairs, war, parks and forests, people, and personnel.

sentences.zh: 六官建，拜計部下大夫。

translations.literal: When the Six Offices were established, appointed lower grand master of accounting.
translations.idiomatic: When the six offices were set up, he was appointed lower grand master of accounting.

sentences.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，轉守廟下大夫。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne, he was transferred to lower grand master who guards the temple.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaomin acceded, Fan was made lower grand master who guards the temple.

sentences.zh: 以選為東道大使，撫巡州防。

translations.literal: By selection he was made eastern-route grand envoy to comfort and inspect provincial garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Selected as eastern-route grand envoy, he toured the provinces to comfort troops and inspect defenses.

sentences.zh: 尋加車騎大將軍、儀同三司，封長樂縣子，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: Soon added General of Chariots and Cavalry and Equal in Protocol to the Three Dukes; enfeoffed Viscount of Changle county with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he received the ranks of general of chariots and cavalry and equal in protocol to the three dukes, and was enfeoffed viscount of Changle with five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 出為玉壁總管府長史。

translations.literal: Sent out as chief clerk of the Yubi headquarters command.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as chief clerk of the Yubi area headquarters.

sentences.zh: 保定中，遷鴻州刺史，入為小納言。

translations.literal: In the Baoding era he was transferred to Inspector of Hong Province; he entered court as junior remonstrating counselor.
translations.idiomatic: During Baoding he became inspector of Hong Province, then entered court as junior remonstrating counselor.

sentences.zh: 俄除隴右總管府司馬，轉陝州總管府長史。

translations.literal: Soon appointed marshal of the Longyou headquarters command; transferred to chief clerk of the Shaan headquarters command.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made marshal of the Longyou headquarters and then transferred to chief clerk of the Shaan headquarters.

sentences.zh: 徵拜蕃部中大夫，進驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Summoned and appointed middle grand master of the Barbarian Affairs Bureau; promoted to Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Opening-Office Equal in Protocol to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Called to court as middle grand master of the Barbarian Affairs Bureau, he was promoted to grand general of agile cavalry and opening-office equal in protocol to the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 復出為隴右總管府長史。

translations.literal: Again sent out as chief clerk of the Longyou headquarters command.
translations.idiomatic: He was again sent out as chief clerk of the Longyou headquarters.

sentences.zh: 璠性平和，小心奉法，安分守志，恒以清白自處。

translations.literal: Fan was even-tempered by nature, careful in observance of law, content in station and steadfast in aim, and always maintained himself in integrity.
translations.idiomatic: By nature Fan was mild and even, careful to obey the law, content with his place and firm in purpose, and always kept himself upright and clean-handed.

sentences.zh: 當時號為善人。

translations.literal: At the time he was called a good man.
translations.idiomatic: Contemporaries hailed him as a man of virtue.

sentences.zh: 建德元年，除民部中大夫。

translations.literal: In Jiande year 1 he was appointed middle grand master of the Ministry of Peoples.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiande he was made middle grand master of the Ministry of Peoples.

sentences.zh: 三年，授隨州刺史。

translations.literal: In year 3 he was given the post of Inspector of Sui Province.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 he was appointed inspector of Sui Province.

sentences.zh: 政存簡惠，百姓安之。

translations.literal: His governance aimed at simplicity and kindness; the common people were at peace under him.
translations.idiomatic: He governed with simplicity and kindness, and the people lived in peace under his rule.

sentences.zh: 其年，增邑幷前二千戶。

translations.literal: That year his fief was increased together with previous holdings to two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: That year his fief, together with what he already held, was raised to two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 六年，卒於位。

translations.literal: In year 6 he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he died at his post.

sentences.zh: 贈交渭二州刺史。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Governor of the two provinces Jiao and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously he was made governor of Jiao and Wei provinces.

sentences.zh: 諡曰恭。

translations.literal: Posthumous name Gong.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous name Gong.

sentences.zh: 子諒，少知名。

translations.literal: His son Liang was known from youth.
translations.idiomatic: His son Liang won notice while still young.

sentences.zh: 大象中，位至吏部下大夫。

translations.literal: In the Daxiang era he reached the post of lower grand master in the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: During Daxiang he rose to lower grand master in the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 辛慶之

translations.literal: Xin Qingzhi
translations.idiomatic: Xin Qingzhi (慶之)

sentences.zh: 辛慶之字慶之，隴西狄道人也。

translations.literal: Xin Qingzhi, styled Qingzhi, was a man of Dida in Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Qingzhi, courtesy name Qingzhi, came from Dida in Longxi.

sentences.zh: 世為隴右著姓。

translations.literal: For generations his clan was a prominent house of Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: His family for generations had been a leading clan of the Longyou region.

sentences.zh: 父顯崇，馮翊郡守，贈雍州刺史。

translations.literal: His father Xianchong was Administrator of Fufeng commandery; posthumously granted Inspector of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xianchong had been administrator of Fufeng commandery and was posthumously made inspector of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 慶之少以文學徵詣洛陽，對策第一，除秘書郎。

translations.literal: Qingzhi in youth was summoned to Luoyang for literary examination; ranked first in the palace debate and was appointed secretariat gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: In youth Qingzhi was summoned to Luoyang on account of his learning; he ranked first in the palace examination and was appointed secretariat gentleman.

sentences.zh: 屬爾朱氏作亂，魏孝莊帝令司空楊津為北道行臺，節度山東諸軍以討之。

translations.literal: When the Erzhu clan raised rebellion, Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei ordered Minister of Works Yang Jin as northern-route mobile headquarters to command the armies of the Shandong region against them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Erzhu faction rebelled, Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei made Minister of Works Yang Jin northern-route mobile headquarters commander to direct the armies of the east against them.

sentences.zh: 津啟慶之為行臺左丞，典參謀議。

translations.literal: Jin proposed Qingzhi as left assistant director of the mobile headquarters in charge of planning counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jin recommended Qingzhi as left assistant director on the mobile headquarters staff, charged with planning and counsel.

sentences.zh: 至鄴，聞孝莊帝暴崩，遂出兗、冀間，謀結義徒，以赴國難。

translations.literal: Reaching Ye, they heard that Emperor Xiaozhuang had died suddenly; they then went out among Yan and Ji provinces, plotting to gather volunteers to answer the national crisis.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Ye and learned that Emperor Xiaozhuang had died suddenly, they withdrew into Yan and Ji and sought to rally volunteers to meet the national emergency.

sentences.zh: 尋而節閔帝立，乃還洛陽。

translations.literal: Before long Emperor Jiemin was enthroned, and they returned to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Emperor Jiemin took the throne, and they returned to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 普泰二年，遷平北將軍、太中大夫。

translations.literal: In Putai year 2 he was transferred to General Who Pacifies the North and grand master of palace counsel.
translations.idiomatic: In Putai year 2 he was made general who pacifies the north and grand master of palace counsel.

sentences.zh: 及賀拔嶽為行臺，復啟慶之為行臺吏部郎中、開府掾。

translations.literal: When Heba Yue became mobile headquarters commander, he again proposed Qingzhi as bureau director in the mobile headquarters personnel section and opening-office staff officer.
translations.idiomatic: When Heba Yue took command of the mobile headquarters, Qingzhi was again recommended as bureau director in the personnel section and opening-office staff officer.

sentences.zh: 尋除雍州別駕。

translations.literal: Soon appointed vice prefect of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made vice prefect of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 大統初，加車騎將軍，俄遷衛大將軍、左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: At the start of Datong he was given the rank General of Chariots and Cavalry; soon transferred to Defender Grand General and left grand master for glorious affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Datong he received the rank of general of chariots and cavalry; soon he was transferred to defender grand general and left grand master for glorious affairs.

sentences.zh: 後太祖東討，為行臺左丞。

translations.literal: Later when the Grand Progenitor campaigned east, he served as left assistant director of the mobile headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai campaigned east, he served as left assistant director on the mobile headquarters staff.

sentences.zh: 時初復河東，以本官兼鹽池都將。

translations.literal: At the time when Hedong had just been recovered, with his existing office he concurrently served as commandant of the salt-works garrison.
translations.idiomatic: When Hedong had just been recovered, he retained his existing rank and concurrently served as commandant of the salt-works garrison.

sentences.zh: 四年，東魏攻正平郡，陷之，遂欲經略鹽池，慶之守禦有備，乃引軍退。

translations.literal: In year 4 Eastern Wei attacked Zhengping commandery and took it; they then intended to seize the salt-works, but Qingzhi's defense was well prepared, and they withdrew their army.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 Eastern Wei attacked Zhengping commandery and captured it, then moved to seize the salt-works; Qingzhi was ready in defense, and the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 河橋之役，大軍不利，河北守令棄城走，慶之獨因鹽池，抗拒強敵。

translations.literal: At the battle of He Bridge the main army fared badly; officials north of the Yellow River abandoned their cities and fled; Qingzhi alone held the salt-works and resisted a strong foe.
translations.idiomatic: At He Bridge the main army suffered defeat; north of the river prefects and magistrates abandoned their posts and fled, but Qingzhi alone held the salt-works and stood against a powerful enemy.

sentences.zh: 時論稱其仁勇。

translations.literal: Contemporary opinion praised his humanity and courage.
translations.idiomatic: Men of the time acclaimed him for both benevolence and bravery.

sentences.zh: 六年，行河東郡事。

translations.literal: In year 6 he acted in the affairs of Hedong commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 he administered Hedong commandery affairs.

sentences.zh: 九年，入為丞相府右長史，兼給事黃門侍郎，除度支尚書。

translations.literal: In year 9 he entered court as right chief clerk of the chancellor's office, concurrently supernumerary gentleman attendant at the yellow gates, and was appointed minister of revenues.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 he entered the chancellor's office as right chief clerk, concurrently served as supernumerary gentleman attendant at the yellow gates, and was appointed minister of revenues.

sentences.zh: 復行河東郡事。

translations.literal: Again acted in Hedong commandery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He again administered Hedong commandery affairs.

sentences.zh: 遷通直散騎常侍、南荊州刺史，加儀同三司。

translations.literal: Transferred to regular attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry and Inspector of South Jing Province; given the added rank Equal in Protocol to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to regular attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry and inspector of South Jing Province, with the added rank of equal in protocol to the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 慶之位遇雖隆，而率性儉素，車馬衣服，亦不尚華侈。

translations.literal: Though Qingzhi's rank and treatment were high, by nature he was frugal and plain; in horses, carriages, and clothing he did not pursue luxury.
translations.idiomatic: Although Qingzhi enjoyed high rank and favor, he was by nature spare and simple and never sought splendor in horses, carriages, or dress.

sentences.zh: 志量淹和，有儒者風度。

translations.literal: His will and capacity were deep and mild; he had the bearing of a scholar.
translations.idiomatic: Broad-minded and gentle in temperament, he carried himself like a Confucian gentleman.

sentences.zh: 特為當時所重。

translations.literal: He was especially valued by the men of his time.
translations.idiomatic: He was held in particular esteem by contemporaries.

sentences.zh: 又以其經明行修，令與盧誕等教授諸王。

translations.literal: Also because he was versed in the classics and upright in conduct, he was ordered together with Lu Dan and others to instruct the princes.
translations.idiomatic: Because he was learned in the classics and upright in conduct, he was ordered with Lu Dan and others to teach the princes.

sentences.zh: 魏廢帝二年，拜秘書監。

translations.literal: In year 2 of Emperor Fei of Wei he was appointed director of the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Emperor Fei of Wei he was made director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 尋卒於位。

translations.literal: Soon he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died at his post.

sentences.zh: 子加陵，主寢上士。

translations.literal: His son Jialing [held the post of] upper gentleman of the palace quarters.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jialing served as upper gentleman of the palace quarters.

sentences.zh: 慶之族子昂。

translations.literal: Qingzhi's clansman Ang.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Qingzhi's clansman was Ang.

sentences.zh: 族子昂

translations.literal: Clansman Ang
translations.idiomatic: His clansman Ang

sentences.zh: 昂字進君。

translations.literal: Ang, styled Jinjun.
translations.idiomatic: Ang, courtesy name Jinjun.

sentences.zh: 年數歲，便有成人志行。

translations.literal: At only a few years of age he already had the will and conduct of a grown man.
translations.idiomatic: While still only a few years old he already showed the purpose and bearing of an adult.

sentences.zh: 有善相人者，謂其父仲略曰：「公家雖世載冠冕，然名德富貴，莫有及此兒者。

translations.literal: A man skilled in physiognomy said to his father Zhonglue: "Though your house for generations has worn official caps, in fame, virtue, wealth, and honor none will surpass this boy.
translations.idiomatic: A physiognomist told his father Zhonglue, "Your family has borne official rank for generations, yet in reputation, virtue, wealth, and high standing none will equal this boy.

sentences.zh: 」仲略亦重昂志氣，深以為然。

translations.literal: " Zhonglue also valued Ang's spirit and resolve and deeply agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhonglue too prized Ang's ambition and fully agreed.

sentences.zh: 年十八，侯景辟為行臺郎中，加鎮遠將軍。

translations.literal: At eighteen Hou Jing recruited him as bureau director of the mobile headquarters with the added rank General Who Pacifies the Distance.
translations.idiomatic: At eighteen he was recruited by Hou Jing as bureau director on the mobile headquarters staff, with the added rank of general who pacifies the distance.

sentences.zh: 景後來附，昂遂入朝。

translations.literal: When Jing later submitted to the court, Ang entered court audience.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing later came over to the court, Ang entered audience at the capital.

sentences.zh: 除丞相府行參軍。

translations.literal: Appointed staff officer in the chancellor's office.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed staff officer in the chancellor's office.

sentences.zh: 大統十四年，追論歸朝之勳，封襄城縣男，邑二百戶，轉丞相府田曹參軍。

translations.literal: In Datong year 14, in review of merit for returning to court he was enfeoffed Baron of Xiangcheng county with a fief of two hundred households and transferred to land-revenue staff officer in the chancellor's office.
translations.idiomatic: In Datong year 14 his merit in returning to court was rewarded with enfeoffment as baron of Xiangcheng, with two hundred households, and he was transferred to land-revenue staff officer in the chancellor's office.

sentences.zh: 及尉遲迥伐蜀，昂召募從軍。

translations.literal: When Yuchi Jiong campaigned against Shu, Ang recruited men and followed the army.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuchi Jiong marched against Shu, Ang raised troops and joined the campaign.

sentences.zh: 蜀平，以功授輔國將軍，魏都督。

translations.literal: When Shu was pacified, for merit he was given the ranks Auxiliary State General and Wei area commander.
translations.idiomatic: After Shu was pacified, he was rewarded for merit with the ranks auxiliary state general and Wei area commander.

sentences.zh: 迥仍表昂為龍州長史，領龍安郡事。

translations.literal: Jiong then memorialized for Ang as chief clerk of Long Province, overseeing affairs of Longan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Yuchi Jiong then memorialized for Ang as chief clerk of Long Province, with charge of Longan commandery affairs.

sentences.zh: 州帶山谷，舊俗生梗。

translations.literal: The province bordered mountain valleys; local custom was rough and obstinate.
translations.idiomatic: The province lay among mountain valleys, and local ways were harsh and unyielding.

sentences.zh: 昂威惠洽著，吏民畏而愛之。

translations.literal: Ang's authority and kindness together won renown; officials and commoners both feared and loved him.
translations.idiomatic: Ang's blend of stern authority and kindness won wide renown; officials and people alike feared yet loved him.

sentences.zh: 成都一方之會，風俗舛雜。

translations.literal: Chengdu was a regional gathering place; customs were mixed and confused.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu was a hub of the region, and local customs were tangled and diverse.

sentences.zh: 迥以昂達於從政，復表昂行成都令。

translations.literal: Jiong, considering Ang skilled in administration, again memorialized for him to act as magistrate of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Because Ang was adept at governing, Yuchi Jiong again memorialized for him to serve as acting magistrate of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 昂到縣，卽與諸生祭文翁學堂，因共歡宴。

translations.literal: When Ang reached the county, he at once with the student scholars offered sacrifice at the Wen Weng academy hall, and they shared a celebratory feast.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching the county seat Ang immediately joined the student scholars in sacrifice at the Wen Weng academy and then feasted with them.

sentences.zh: 謂諸生曰：「子孝臣忠，師嚴友信，立身之要，如斯而已。

translations.literal: He told the students: "Filial as sons, loyal as ministers, strict as teachers, trustworthy as friends — the essentials of establishing oneself are no more than this.
translations.idiomatic: He said to the students, "Be filial as sons and loyal as ministers; be strict as teachers and faithful as friends — these are the essentials of making a name for oneself.

sentences.zh: 若不事斯語，何以成名。

translations.literal: If you do not act on these words, how can you achieve a reputation?
translations.idiomatic: If you do not follow this teaching, how will you win renown?

sentences.zh: 各宜自勉，克成令譽。

translations.literal: Each of you should exert yourselves and fulfill a fine reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Each of you should strive to earn a good name.

sentences.zh: 」昂言切理至，諸生等並深感悟，歸而告其父老曰：「辛君教誡如此，不可違之。

translations.literal: " Ang's words were earnest and to the point; the students were all deeply moved, and returning home they told their elders: "Master Xin's admonition is such as this — it cannot be disobeyed.
translations.idiomatic: " Ang spoke with force and clarity; the students were deeply moved and, on returning home, told their elders, "Master Xin's instruction is such as this — we cannot disregard it.

sentences.zh: 」於是井邑肅然，咸從其化。

translations.literal: " Thereupon villages and towns became orderly; all followed his influence.
translations.idiomatic: " From that time villages and market towns grew orderly, and all submitted to his influence.

sentences.zh: 遷梓潼郡守，進位帥都督，加通直散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Transferred to Administrator of Zitong commandery; advanced to commandery-level area commander; given the added rank regular attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to administrator of Zitong commandery, promoted to commandery-level area commander, and given the added rank of regular attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry.

sentences.zh: 六官建，入為司隸上士，襲爵繁昌縣公。

translations.literal: When the Six Offices were established, he entered court as upper gentleman of the Directorate of Metropolitan Investigation; inherited the title Duke of Fanchang county.
translations.idiomatic: When the Six Offices were established he entered court as upper gentleman of the Directorate of Metropolitan Investigation and inherited the title duke of Fanchang county.

sentences.zh: 世宗初，授天官府上士，加大都督。

translations.literal: At the start of Emperor Shizong's reign he was appointed upper gentleman of the Celestial Bureau and given the rank of great area commander.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Emperor Shizong's reign he was made upper gentleman of the Celestial Bureau and promoted to great area commander.

sentences.zh: 武成二年，授小職方下大夫，治小兵部。

translations.literal: In Wucheng year 2 he was appointed lower grand master of the minor Bureau of Frontiers and managed the minor military bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Wucheng year 2 he was made lower grand master of the minor Bureau of Frontiers and put in charge of the minor military bureau.

sentences.zh: 保定二年，進車騎大將軍、儀同三司，轉小吏部。

translations.literal: In Baoding year 2 he was promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry and Equal in Protocol to the Three Dukes; transferred to the minor Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In Baoding year 2 he rose to general of chariots and cavalry and equal in protocol to the three dukes, and was transferred to the minor Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 四年，大軍東討，昂與大將軍權景宣下豫州，以功賞布帛二百匹。

translations.literal: In year 4, when the great army campaigned east, Ang with Grand General Quan Jingxuan descended on Yu Province; for merit he was rewarded with two hundred bolts of cloth and silk.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4, when the main army marched east, Ang followed Grand General Quan Jingxuan into Yu Province and was rewarded with two hundred bolts of cloth and silk for his merit.

sentences.zh: 時益州殷阜，軍國所資。

translations.literal: At the time Yi Province was rich and prosperous, supplying what army and state required.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Province was then wealthy and fertile, providing resources for army and state alike.

sentences.zh: 經塗艱險，每苦劫盜。

translations.literal: The routes were rugged and dangerous; bandits and robbers were a constant trouble.
translations.idiomatic: The roads were steep and perilous, and brigands plagued every journey.

sentences.zh: 詔昂使於梁、益，軍民之務，皆委決焉。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Ang as envoy to Liang and Yi; military and civil affairs were all entrusted to his decision.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Ang envoy to Liang and Yi, with full authority over military and civil matters.

sentences.zh: 昂撫導荒梗，安置城鎮，數年之中，頗得寧靜。

translations.literal: Ang pacified and guided the wild frontier, established towns and garrisons, and within several years achieved considerable peace.
translations.idiomatic: Ang soothed the untamed frontier, settled towns and garrisons, and within a few years brought the region to relative calm.

sentences.zh: 天和初，陸騰討信州群蠻，歷時未克。

translations.literal: At the start of Tianhe, Lu Teng campaigned against the tribal peoples of Xin Province and for a long time could not subdue them.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Tianhe, Lu Teng fought the tribal peoples of Xin Province but for a long time could not overcome them.

sentences.zh: 高祖詔昂便於通、渠等諸州運糧饋之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaoyu ordered Ang to transport grain conveniently from Tong, Qu, and other provinces to supply them.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaoyu ordered Ang to move grain from Tong, Qu, and the other provinces to feed the campaign.

sentences.zh: 時臨、信、楚、合等諸州民庶，亦多從逆。

translations.literal: At the time common people of Lin, Xin, Chu, He, and other provinces also mostly followed the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the people of Lin, Xin, Chu, He, and other provinces had largely joined the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 昂諭以禍福，赴者如歸。

translations.literal: Ang expounded benefit and harm to them; those who came to him returned as if to home.
translations.idiomatic: Ang explained fortune and disaster to them, and those who came over did so as gladly as returning home.

sentences.zh: 乃令老弱負糧，壯夫拒戰，咸願為用，莫有怨者。

translations.literal: He then had the aged and weak carry grain and strong men resist in battle; all wished to serve him and none complained.
translations.idiomatic: He set the old and weak to carry grain and the able-bodied to fight; all were willing to serve, and none grumbled.

sentences.zh: 使還，屬巴州萬榮郡民反叛，攻圍郡城，遏絕山路。

translations.literal: On his return from the mission, the people of Wanrong commandery in Ba Province rebelled, besieged the commandery seat, and cut off the mountain roads.
translations.idiomatic: When he returned from his mission, the people of Wanrong commandery in Ba Province rebelled, besieged the commandery city, and blocked the mountain routes.

sentences.zh: 昂謂其同侶曰：「凶奴狂悖，一至於此！

translations.literal: Ang said to his companions: "These villains are wildly rebellious — to this extent!
translations.idiomatic: Ang told his companions, "These rebels are mad with defiance — to go this far!

sentences.zh: 若待上聞，或淹旬月，孤城無援，必淪寇黨。

translations.literal: If we wait for word from above, it may take a month or more; the isolated city has no relief and will surely fall to the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: If we wait for orders from the capital, a month may pass; the isolated city has no help and will certainly be lost to the rebels.

sentences.zh: 欲救近溺，寧暇遠求越人。

translations.literal: To save one drowning nearby, who has leisure to seek a man from Yue far away?
translations.idiomatic: When someone is drowning at hand, there is no time to fetch a rescuer from distant Yue.

sentences.zh: 苟利百姓，專之可也。

translations.literal: If it benefits the people, one may take sole responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: If it serves the people's good, one may act on one's own authority.

sentences.zh: 」於是遂募開、通二州，得三千人，倍道兼行，出其不意。

translations.literal: Thereupon he recruited from Kai and Tong provinces, got three thousand men, marched by forced marches day and night, and struck where they did not expect.
translations.idiomatic: He then raised troops from Kai and Tong provinces, gathered three thousand men, marched at double speed day and night, and fell on the enemy by surprise.

sentences.zh: 又令其衆皆作中國歌，直趣賊壘。

translations.literal: He also had his troops all sing Chinese songs and march straight at the rebel camp.
translations.idiomatic: He further ordered his men to sing Chinese songs as they marched straight for the rebel stronghold.

sentences.zh: 賊旣不以為虞，謂有大軍赴救，於是望風瓦解，郡境獲寧。

translations.literal: The rebels had not suspected him; thinking a great army was coming to the rescue, they scattered at the rumor of his approach and the commandery territory was secured.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels had taken no precautions; believing a large relief force was coming, they broke and fled at his approach, and the commandery was restored to peace.

sentences.zh: 朝廷嘉其權以濟事，詔梁州總管、杞國公亮卽於軍中賞昂奴婢二十口、繒彩四百匹。

translations.literal: The court praised his timely use of authority to accomplish the task; ordered Area Commander of Liang Province, Duke of Qi Yuwen Liang, to reward Ang on the spot in the army with twenty household slaves and four hundred bolts of colored silk.
translations.idiomatic: The court commended his bold use of discretion to save the situation and ordered Liang Province area commander Duke of Qi Yuwen Liang to reward Ang in camp with twenty household slaves and four hundred bolts of colored silk.

sentences.zh: 亮又以昂威信布於宕渠，遂表為渠州刺史。

translations.literal: Liang, because Ang's authority and trust had spread through Dangqu, then memorialized for him as Inspector of Qu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Because Ang's reputation and good faith had spread through Dangqu, Yuwen Liang memorialized for him as inspector of Qu Province.

sentences.zh: 俄轉通州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon transferred to Inspector of Tong Province.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to inspector of Tong Province.

sentences.zh: 昂推誠布信，甚得夷獠歡心。

translations.literal: Ang extended sincerity and spread good faith; he won the hearts of the Yi and Liao peoples.
translations.idiomatic: Ang dealt with them in sincerity and trust, and won the warm regard of the Yi and Liao tribes.

sentences.zh: 秩滿還京，首領皆隨昂詣闕朝覲。

translations.literal: When his term ended he returned to the capital; tribal leaders all followed Ang to court audience.
translations.idiomatic: When his term expired and he returned to the capital, tribal chiefs all accompanied Ang to audience at court.

sentences.zh: 以昂化洽夷華，進位驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Because Ang's influence had harmonized barbarian and Chinese, he was promoted to Grand General of Agile Cavalry and Opening-Office Equal in Protocol to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Because Ang had civilized both tribal peoples and Chinese subjects, he was promoted to grand general of agile cavalry and opening-office equal in protocol to the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 時晉公護執政，昂稍被護親待，高祖以是頗銜之。

translations.literal: At the time Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu held power; Ang was somewhat treated as Hu's kin; Emperor Xiaoyu for this bore considerable resentment.
translations.idiomatic: While Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu ran the government, Ang was shown something like familial favor by Hu; Emperor Xiaoyu deeply resented this.

sentences.zh: 及護誅，加之捶楚，因此遂卒。

translations.literal: When Hu was executed, [Ang] was subjected to beating and flogging; because of this he thereupon died.
translations.idiomatic: When Hu was put to death, Ang was beaten and flogged and died from it.

sentences.zh: 昂族人仲景，好學，有雅量。

translations.literal: Ang's clansman Zhongjing loved learning and had refined magnanimity.
translations.idiomatic: Ang's clansman Zhongjing was devoted to learning and had a generous, cultured bearing.

sentences.zh: 其高祖欽，後趙吏部尚書、雍州刺史，子孫因家焉。

translations.literal: His high ancestor Qin was Minister of the Ministry of Personnel and Inspector of Yong Province under Later Zhao; descendants therefore made their home there.
translations.idiomatic: His distant ancestor Qin had been Later Zhao minister of personnel and inspector of Yong; the family settled there and remained.

sentences.zh: 父歡，魏隴州刺史、宋陽公。

translations.literal: His father Huan was Inspector of Long Province under Wei and Duke of Songyang.
translations.idiomatic: His father Huan had been inspector of Long Province under Wei and duke of Songyang.

sentences.zh: 仲景年十八，舉文學，對策高第。

translations.literal: Zhongjing at age eighteen was recommended for literary studies; in the palace debate he ranked in the highest grade.
translations.idiomatic: At eighteen Zhongjing was nominated for literary office and ranked at the top in the palace examination.

sentences.zh: 拜司空府主簿，遷員外散騎侍郎。

translations.literal: Appointed chief clerk of the Bureau of the Minister of Works; transferred to supernumerary attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed chief clerk in the minister of works' office and later promoted to supernumerary attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry.

sentences.zh: 建德中，位至內史下大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: During Jiande he reached the post of lower grand master of the Inner Scribe and Opening-Office Equal in Protocol to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: During Jiande he rose to lower grand master of the Inner Scribe and opening-office equal in protocol to the three dukes.

sentences.zh: 卒於官。

translations.literal: He died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died at his post.

sentences.zh: 子衡。

translations.literal: His son Heng.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Heng.

sentences.zh: 王子直

translations.literal: Wang Zizhi
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zizhi (直)

sentences.zh: 王子直字孝正，京兆杜陵人也。

translations.literal: Wang Zizhi, styled Xiaozheng, was a man of Duling in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zizhi, courtesy name Xiaozheng, came from Duling in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 世為郡右族。

translations.literal: For generations a leading clan of the commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His family had long been one of the commandery's foremost houses.

sentences.zh: 父琳，州主簿、東雍州長史。

translations.literal: His father Lin was provincial chief clerk and chief administrator of eastern Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: His father Lin had been provincial chief clerk and chief administrator of eastern Yong.

sentences.zh: 子直性節儉，有幹能。

translations.literal: Zizhi by nature was frugal and abstemious, and had administrative talent.
translations.idiomatic: Zizhi was frugal by nature and capable in affairs.

sentences.zh: 魏正光中，州辟主簿，起家奉朝請。

translations.literal: In the Wei Zhengguang era the province recruited him as chief clerk; he first took office as palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: During Wei Zhengguang the province made him chief clerk, and he entered service as palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 除太尉府水曹行參軍，加明威將軍。

translations.literal: Appointed acting adjutant of the water bureau in the Grand Commandant's office; given the added rank General of Bright Might.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed acting adjutant in the water bureau of the grand commandant's office and given the added rank of general of bright might.

sentences.zh: 時梁人圍壽春，臨淮王元彧率軍赴援，子直以本官參彧軍事。

translations.literal: At the time Liang forces besieged Shouchun; Prince of Huai'nan Yuan Yu led troops to relieve them; Zizhi in his existing office joined Yu's military staff.
translations.idiomatic: When Liang troops besieged Shouchun and Prince of Huai'nan Yuan Yu marched to relieve the city, Zizhi joined Yu's staff in his existing rank.

sentences.zh: 與梁人戰，斬其軍主夏侯景超，梁人乃退。

translations.literal: Battling Liang forces, he beheaded their army commander Xiahou Jingchao; the Liang men thereupon withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In battle with the Liang he killed their commander Xiahou Jingchao, and the Liang army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 淮南民庶因兵寇之後，猶聚為盜。

translations.literal: The common people of Huainan after the military calamities still gathered and became bandits.
translations.idiomatic: After the fighting, the people of Huainan still banded together as marauders.

sentences.zh: 彧令子直招撫之，旬日之間，咸來復業，自合肥以北，安堵如舊。

translations.literal: Yu ordered Zizhi to summon and comfort them; within ten days and more they all came to resume their occupations; from Hefei northward, peace and order were as before.
translations.idiomatic: Yu put Zizhi in charge of winning them back; within ten days all had returned to their livelihoods, and from Hefei northward order was restored.

sentences.zh: 永安初，拜員外散騎常侍、鴻臚少卿。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yong'an, appointed supernumerary regular attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry and Vice Director of the Chamberlain for Dependencies.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Yong'an he was made supernumerary regular attendant-in-ordinary of the scattered cavalry and vice director of the chamberlain for dependencies.

sentences.zh: 普泰初，進後軍將軍、太中大夫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Putai, promoted to Rear Guard General and Grand Master of Palace Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Putai he was promoted to rear guard general and grand master of palace attendance.

sentences.zh: 賀拔岳入關，以子直為開府主簿，遷行臺郎中。

translations.literal: When Heba Yue entered the Pass, Zizhi was made chief clerk of the opening office and transferred to mobile headquarters gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: When Heba Yue entered the Pass, Zizhi was appointed chief clerk on his staff and then mobile headquarters gentleman.

sentences.zh: 魏孝武西遷，封山北縣男，邑二百戶。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu of Wei moved west, enfeoffed Baron of Shanbei county with fief of two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu moved west, Zizhi was enfeoffed baron of Shanbei with a fief of two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 大統初，漢熾屠各阻兵於南山，與隴東屠各共為唇齒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Datong, Han-chi Tuyuhun blocked arms at Southern Mountain, with Longdong Tuyuhun sharing lips and teeth.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Datong the Han-chi Tuyuhun took up arms in the Southern Mountains, allied with the Longdong Tuyuhun as mutual support.

sentences.zh: 太祖令子直率涇州步騎五千討破之，南山平。

translations.literal: Grand Progenitor ordered Zizhi to lead five thousand infantry and cavalry of Jing Province to attack and defeat them; Southern Mountain was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai ordered Zizhi to lead five thousand foot and horse from Jing Province against them; the Southern Mountains were pacified.

sentences.zh: 太祖嘉之，賜書勞問。

translations.literal: Grand Progenitor commended him and granted a letter of reward and inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai praised him and sent a letter of commendation.

sentences.zh: 除尚書左外兵郎中。

translations.literal: Appointed outer troops gentleman of the left in the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed outer troops gentleman of the left in the masters of writing.

sentences.zh: 三年，進車騎將軍，兼中書舍人。

translations.literal: Year 3, promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry and concurrently Secretariat Aide.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 he was made general of chariots and cavalry and concurrent secretariat aide.

sentences.zh: 四年，從太祖解洛陽圍，經河橋戰，兼尚書左丞，出為秦州總管府司馬。

translations.literal: Year 4, followed Grand Progenitor to relieve the siege of Luoyang; passing through battle at Heqiao; concurrently Left Assistant Director of the Masters of Writing; sent out as marshal of the Qin Province headquarters command.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he followed Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai to lift the siege of Luoyang and fought at Heqiao, served concurrently as left assistant director of the masters of writing, and was sent out as marshal of the Qin Province headquarters.

sentences.zh: 時涼州刺史宇文仲和據州逆命，子直從隴右大都督獨孤信討平之。

translations.literal: At the time Inspector of Liang Province Yuwen Zhonghe held the province in defiance of orders; Zizhi followed Longyou area commander Dugu Xin to attack and pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: When Liang Province inspector Yuwen Zhonghe rebelled and held the province, Zizhi followed Longyou area commander Dugu Xin and put down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 復入為大行臺郎中，兼丞相府記室。

translations.literal: Again entered as gentleman of the great mobile headquarters and concurrently recording secretary of the chancellor's office.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to court as gentleman of the great mobile headquarters and recording secretary on the chancellor's staff.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾寇西平，以子直兼尚書兵部郎中，出隴右經略之，大破渾衆於長寧川，渾賊遁走。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun raided Xiping; Zizhi was made concurrent troops bureau gentleman in the Masters of Writing, sent out to Longyou to handle affairs; greatly defeated the Hun force at Changning River; Hun bandits fled.
translations.idiomatic: When Tuyuhun raided Xiping, Zizhi was sent to Longyou as concurrent troops bureau gentleman in the masters of writing; he routed the Tuyuhun at Changning River and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 十五年，進車騎將軍、左光祿大夫，除太子中庶子，領齊王友。

translations.literal: Year 15, promoted to General of Chariots and Cavalry and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness; appointed junior tutor of the crown prince; concurrently friend to the Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 he was made general of chariots and cavalry and left grand master of splendid happiness, appointed junior tutor to the crown prince, and companion to the Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 尋行馮翊郡事。

translations.literal: Soon acting administrator of Fengyi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he governed Fengyi commandery in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 十六年，魏齊王廓出牧秦隴，復以子直為秦州別駕，仍領王友。

translations.literal: Year 16, Prince of Qi of Wei Kuo went out to hold Qin and Long; again made Zizhi vice-prefect of Qin Province; still concurrently prince's friend.
translations.idiomatic: In year 16, when Prince of Qi Kuo went out to govern Qin and Long, Zizhi was again made vice-prefect of Qin Province while continuing as the prince's companion.

sentences.zh: 隨、陸初平，授安州長史，領別駕，加帥都督。

translations.literal: Sui and Lu first pacified; granted Chief Administrator of An Province; concurrently vice-prefect; given added rank area commander.
translations.idiomatic: After Sui and Lu were pacified he was made chief administrator of An Province with vice-prefect duties and the added rank of area commander.

sentences.zh: 轉幷州長史。

translations.literal: Transferred to chief administrator of Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to chief administrator of Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 魏廢帝元年，拜使持節、大都督，行瓜州事。

translations.literal: In year 1 of Emperor Fei of Wei, appointed Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Great Area Commander, acting Gua Province affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Fei of Wei he was made bearer of the staff of authority and great area commander, governing Gua Province in an acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 子直性清靜，務以德政化民，西土悅附。

translations.literal: Zizhi by nature was pure and quiet; he devoted himself to governing the people through virtue; the western lands gladly submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Quiet and upright by nature, Zizhi sought to civilize the people through virtuous government, and the western regions gladly followed him.

sentences.zh: 魏恭帝初，徵拜黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wei Gongdi, summoned and appointed Palace Gate Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Wei Gongdi's reign he was summoned and made palace gate gentleman.

sentences.zh: 卒於位。

translations.literal: Died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died at his post.

sentences.zh: 子宣禮，柱國府參軍事。

translations.literal: His son Xuanli [was] staff officer on the pillar state's headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xuanli served as staff officer on a pillar state's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 杜杲字子暉，京兆杜陵人也。

translations.literal: Du Gao, styled Zihui, was a man of Duling in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Du Gao, courtesy name Zihui, came from Duling in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 祖建，魏輔國將軍，贈豫州刺史。

translations.literal: His grandfather Jian was General Who Supports the State under Wei, posthumously granted Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Jian had been general who supports the state under Wei and was posthumously made governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 父皎，儀同三司、武都郡守。

translations.literal: His father Jiao was Equal in Protocol to the Three Dukes and Administrator of Wudu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His father Jiao had held equal in protocol to the three dukes and been administrator of Wudu commandery.

sentences.zh: 杲學涉經史，有當世幹略。

translations.literal: Gao's learning ranged through the classics and histories; he had contemporary administrative talent and stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Gao was well read in the classics and histories and had practical talent for his age.

sentences.zh: 其族父瓚，清貞有識鑒，深器重之。

translations.literal: His clansman-uncle Zan was pure and upright, had discernment, and deeply valued him.
translations.idiomatic: His clansman Zan was upright and discerning and thought highly of him.

sentences.zh: 常曰：「吾家千里駒也。

translations.literal: He often said: "The thousand-li colt of our house.
translations.idiomatic: Zan often said, "He is the fine steed of our clan.

sentences.zh: 」瓚時仕魏為黃門侍郎，兼度支尚書、衛大將軍、西道行臺，尚孝武妹新豐公主，因薦之於朝廷。

translations.literal: " At the time Zan served Wei as Palace Gate Gentleman, concurrently Minister of the Ministry of Revenue, Grand General of the Guard, and western-route mobile headquarters; married Emperor Xiaowu's younger sister Princess Xinfeng; therefore recommended him to the court.
translations.idiomatic: " Zan then served Wei as palace gate gentleman, concurrent minister of revenue, grand general of the guard, and western-route mobile headquarters commander; married Emperor Xiaowu's sister, Princess Xinfeng, and on that account recommended Gao at court.

sentences.zh: 永熙三年，起家奉朝請，累遷輔國將軍、成州長史、漢陽郡守。

translations.literal: Yongxi year 3, first took office as palace attendant; progressively transferred to General Who Supports the State, chief administrator of Cheng Province, and Administrator of Hanyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi year 3 he entered service as palace attendant and rose in succession to general who supports the state, chief administrator of Cheng Province, and administrator of Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 世宗初，轉脩城郡守。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shizong's reign, transferred to Administrator of Xiucheng commandery.
translations.idiomatic: At the opening of Emperor Shizong's reign he became administrator of Xiucheng commandery.

sentences.zh: 屬鳳州人仇周貢等構亂，攻逼脩城，杲信洽於民，部內遂無叛者。

translations.literal: It happened that men of Feng Province Qiu Zhougong and others fomented disorder, attacking and pressing Xiucheng; Gao's trust harmonized with the people; within his district thereupon were none who rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: When Feng Province natives Qiu Zhougong and others rebelled and attacked Xiucheng, Gao's good faith among the people kept his district from joining the revolt.

sentences.zh: 尋而開府趙昶諸軍進討，杲率郡兵與昶合勢，遂破平之。

translations.literal: Before long opening-office Zhao Chang led the armies forward to attack; Gao led commandery troops to combine forces with Chang; thereupon defeated and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Chang and other commanders marched to suppress the rebels, Gao led the commandery militia to join him and crushed the uprising.

sentences.zh: 入為司

translations.literal: He entered the capital as Si
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital as

translations.literal: (ming) [emended: 會]
translations.idiomatic: [emended: Revisions (Hui)]

sentences.zh: 〔會〕上士。

translations.literal: 〔會〕 upper steward.
translations.idiomatic: upper steward in the Bureau of Revisions.

sentences.zh: 初，陳文帝弟安成王頊為質於梁，及江陵平，頊隨例遷長安。

translations.literal: Initially, Chen Wendi's younger brother King of Ancheng Xu was hostage at Liang; when Jiangling was pacified, Xu followed precedent and was moved to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Emperor Wen of Chen's younger brother, King Xu of Ancheng, had been a hostage in Liang; after the fall of Jiangling he was transferred to Chang'an like the others.

sentences.zh: 陳人請之，太祖許而未遣。

translations.literal: Chen people requested him; Grand Progenitor agreed but did not send him.
translations.idiomatic: Chen asked for his return; Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai agreed but did not send him back.

sentences.zh: 至是，帝欲歸之，命杲使焉。

translations.literal: At this time the Emperor wished to return him; ordered Gao to serve as envoy there.
translations.idiomatic: Now the emperor wished to send Xu home and appointed Du Gao envoy to Chen.

sentences.zh: 陳文帝大悅，卽遣使報聘，並賂黔中數州之地。

translations.literal: Chen Wendi greatly rejoiced; immediately sent envoys on a return visit, and also offered the lands of several provinces in Qianzhong as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen of Chen was delighted and at once sent envoys in return, offering several Qianzhong prefectures as a gift.

sentences.zh: 仍請畫野分疆，永敦鄰好。

translations.literal: Still requested mapping fields and dividing borders, forever honoring neighborly friendship.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to fix the border and pledged lasting good relations.

sentences.zh: 以杲奉使稱旨，進授都督，治小御伯，更往分界焉。

translations.literal: Because Gao on embassy accorded with the imperial intent, promoted and granted Area Commander, administered Lesser Chariot Earl, again went to demarcate the border.
translations.idiomatic: Because Du Gao had carried out his mission to the emperor's satisfaction, he was promoted to area commander and made lesser charioteer earl, then sent again to mark out the frontier.

sentences.zh: 陳人於是以魯山歸我。

translations.literal: Chen people thereupon with Lushan returned to us.
translations.idiomatic: Chen then ceded Lushan to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 帝乃拜頊柱國大將軍，詔杲送之還國。

translations.literal: The Emperor thereupon appointed Xu Pillar State Grand General; ordered Gao to escort him in returning to his state.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou emperor made Xu a pillar state grand general and ordered Du Gao to escort him home.

sentences.zh: 陳文帝謂杲曰：「家弟今蒙禮遣，實是周朝之惠。

translations.literal: Chen Wendi said to Gao: "My younger brother now receives courteous dispatch; truly it is the Zhou court's grace.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen of Chen told Du Gao, "My brother is being sent home with full honors — that is truly a kindness from your court.

sentences.zh: 然不還彼魯山，亦恐未能及此。

translations.literal: Yet if not returning that Lushan, I fear one could not have reached this point.
translations.idiomatic: Yet without returning Lushan, I doubt we could have achieved even this.

sentences.zh: 」杲答曰：「安成之在關中，乃咸陽一布衣耳。

translations.literal: " Gao answered: "Ancheng in Guanzhong was merely a common cloth-clad man of Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: " Du Gao replied, "While Prince Xu of Ancheng was in Guanzhong he was no more than a commoner in Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 然是陳之介弟，其價豈止一城。

translations.literal: Yet he is Chen's eminent younger brother; his worth — how could it stop at one walled city!
translations.idiomatic: But he is your honored younger brother — surely he is worth more than a single city.

sentences.zh: 本朝親睦九族，恕己及物，上遵太祖遺旨，下思繼好之義。

translations.literal: Our dynasty treats the nine clans with closeness, forgives self and extends to things; above follows Grand Progenitor's testamentary intent, below considers the meaning of continuing good relations.
translations.idiomatic: Our court cherishes kinship, shows forbearance, honors Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai's will, and seeks to keep peace between our states.

sentences.zh: 所以發德音者，蓋為此也。

translations.literal: The reason for issuing virtuous words is probably for this.
translations.idiomatic: That is why we issued this gracious decree.

sentences.zh: 若知止侔魯山，固當不貪一鎮。

translations.literal: If one knew stopping equals Lushan, certainly should not be greedy for one garrison.
translations.idiomatic: If you imagine we would settle for no more than Lushan, we are hardly greedy enough to haggle over a single town.

sentences.zh: 況魯山梁之舊地，梁卽本朝蕃臣，若以始末言之，魯山自合歸國。

translations.literal: Moreover Lushan was Liang's old territory; Liang is our dynasty's tributary subject; if speaking from beginning to end, Lushan naturally ought to return to the state.
translations.idiomatic: Besides, Lushan was formerly Liang territory, and Liang is a vassal of our court — by rights Lushan belongs to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 云以尋常之土，易己骨肉之親，使臣猶謂不可，何以聞諸朝廷。

translations.literal: Saying with ordinary land to exchange one's flesh-and-blood kin — even I the envoy still say it cannot be; how to report this to the court.
translations.idiomatic: To exchange kin for an ordinary scrap of land — even your envoy finds that unacceptable; how could I report such a thing to our court?

sentences.zh: 」陳文帝慚恧久之，乃曰：「前言戲之耳。

translations.literal: " Chen Wendi ashamed and abashed for a long time, then said: "Earlier words were in jest.
translations.idiomatic: " Emperor Wen of Chen was silent with embarrassment for a long moment, then said, "I was only joking earlier.

sentences.zh: 」自是接遇有加常禮。

translations.literal: " From this onward reception and treatment were added beyond the usual rites.
translations.idiomatic: " From then on Chen received him with exceptional courtesy.

sentences.zh: 及杲還，命引升殿，親降御座，執手以別。

translations.literal: When Gao returned, ordered to lead him up the hall; personally descended from the imperial seat; clasped hands to part.
translations.idiomatic: When Du Gao was leaving, the emperor had him brought into the hall, came down from the throne in person, and clasped his hand in farewell.

sentences.zh: 朝廷嘉之，授大都督、小載師下大夫，治小納言，復聘於陳。

translations.literal: The court commended him; granted Great Area Commander, Lower Grand Master Chariot Master Lesser, administered Lesser Remonstrating Counselor, again envoy to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou court praised his service and made him great area commander, lower grand master chariot master, and lesser remonstrating counselor, then sent him again as envoy to Chen.
